name: web-fatis-donut-site-on-laptop-in-pink-cafe-render
title: Fati's hero on a laptop atop a glossy pink table in a rendered pink café with a donut and mug
whatItIs: A rendered pink café scene: a laptop on a glossy round pink table shows the 'Sweet Moments for Every Craving' hero with a Matilda donut, beside a real pink donut on a plate and a speckled mug, with a glowing donut sign, plants and a city window behind.
whatItMeans: Immersive and on-brand; the whole room is dressed in the brand colour so the site feels at home.
techniques: Build the mockup environment in the brand colour.
Echo the on-screen product with a real prop.
Use a glossy surface for reflections.

vocabulary.definition: A setting styled entirely in brand colours.
A physical object repeating what's on screen.
